entries.reason: Reviewed the complete Webpack production-browser case and asset producers. Production HTML minification removes optional attribute quotes, so the raw HTML substring checks are represented by browser DOM checks with the same rel/as/href, defer, empty crossorigin and last-body-element requirements. The missing exact Manifest href prefix and empty crossorigin checks were restored, and singleton counts strengthen duplicate-injection coverage. CSS display/layer placement assertions remain. The rebuilt published bundle passes the browser case, lint passes, and the unchanged shared manifest-preload unit test still pins exact serializer bytes. This verifies preserved injection semantics, not parity of the bundler's optional quote formatting.
